title: Introduction
content:
Hi, I’m Lloyd Joshua M. Matobato, a second-year Computer Science student at AdDU. I’m currently deep-diving into the structure of Java, finding that I enjoy the challenge of pushing the language to its limits to see what I can build.

My early projects include a speed-scaling mobile game and a custom soundboard developed in MIT App Inventor. These taught me the core logic of user interaction and event-driven programming. Beyond the classroom, I like to play casual games and consuming media of the VTubing scene, which has led me to explore the intersection of tech and entertainment. Whether it's experimenting with video and image editing for high-effort "media creations" or finding ways to integrate my coding knowledge into the games I play, I’m always looking for ways to bridge the gap between technical logic and creative chaos.
